youtube.title: Why the Room Keeps Spinning After You Stop 🌀 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Dizziness after spinning comes from the inner ear. Three fluid-filled loops called the semicircular canals sense rotation by bending tiny hair cells as the fluid moves. After you stop, the fluid keeps swirling for a few seconds, so your brain still gets a spinning signal while your eyes see a still room. Your eyes jerk in response, which is called nystagmus.
